accepted.title: Thứ tự nội dung bị chèn ảnh ở giữa trong khối OneAino
anchors: Aino delivers a fully integrated ecosystem
accepted.detail: Trong thiết kế, toàn bộ tiêu đề, đoạn văn mô tả và nút CTA nằm chung trong một khối văn bản cạnh ảnh. Trên giao diện tablet, ảnh minh hoạ lại bị chèn vào giữa tiêu đề ('One integrated platform...') và đoạn mô tả ('Aino delivers a fully integrated ecosystem...'), làm ngắt quãng luồng đọc của người dùng.

accepted.title: Thứ tự hiển thị nội dung bị ngắt quãng bởi hình ảnh
anchors: Reliability is what everyone is actually buying.
Built here. Hosted here. Accountable here.
accepted.detail: Ở 3 khối nội dung bên dưới, tiêu đề bị tách rời khỏi đoạn văn miêu tả và nút CTA (tiêu đề nằm trên ảnh, đoạn mô tả và nút CTA lại nằm dưới ảnh), làm ngắt quãng luồng đọc thay vì gom toàn bộ khối chữ cùng nhau khi xếp chồng dọc trên tablet.

accepted.title: "One integrated platform" text is split by the image
anchors: Aino delivers a fully integrated ecosystem
accepted.detail:
Design: Eyebrow, heading, paragraph, and CTA button sit together in a single text block beside the image.
Live: The solar image is placed between the heading and the supporting paragraph and CTA button.

accepted.title: Middle insights card is missing its thumbnail image
anchors: Understanding Time-of-Use Tariffs for Commercial Sites
accepted.detail:
Design: all three insight cards show a photo above the headline.
Live: the middle card ("Understanding Time-of-Use Tariffs for Commercial Sites") has no image, leaving a blank white area above the text.

accepted.title: The hero takes too much of the first screen
accepted.detail:
Design: the opening banner fits the heading, supporting copy and CTA high within the hero so the page feels dense immediately.
Live: the hero image and top spacing consume almost the whole first screen, pushing the next section well below the fold.

accepted.title: The intro statement is too faint to read
anchors: Every year, Australia generates more renewable energy.
Aino exists to close that gap.
accepted.detail:
Design: the large paragraph under the hero keeps strong dark emphasis on the opening lines.
Live: the same paragraph below “Request a meeting” is washed out in very pale grey, making the key message hard to read.

accepted.title: Industry cards are cropped off at the screen edges
accepted.detail:
Design: the industry tiles are fully framed in a clean row with each card visible.
Live: the left and right cards are cut off by the viewport, so the card set looks clipped rather than intentionally laid out.

accepted.title: Hero section headline pushed too far down on mobile
anchors: Protecting what you've built, for those you love.
accepted.detail:
Design: Headline "Protecting what you've built, for those you love." appears in the upper half of the hero, with substantial text and CTAs visible in the first screen.
Live: On mobile, the same headline is positioned much lower; the first screen (y 0–844) is dominated by the video region (y 104–624) with headline text starting around y 625, leaving the top third of the first screen mostly empty.

accepted.title: Stats row layout collapses to single column with excessive vertical spacing
accepted.detail:
Design: Four stat items (1947, 40+, 2,000+, QLD) are displayed horizontally in a compact row below the hero.
Live: Stats are stacked vertically with large gaps between each pair, consuming much more vertical space and pushing subsequent content further down the page.

accepted.title: Our Purpose section layout changed from two-column to four-column grid
accepted.detail:
Design: 'Our Purpose. Our Values.' heading with two value cards below (Holistic Approach, Genuine Service) in a two-column layout
Live: Same heading but four value cards displayed in a 2×2 grid (Holistic Approach, Genuine Service, Thoughtful Guidance, Decades of Experience)

accepted.title: Decorative line elements removed from Our Purpose section
accepted.detail:
Design: Two small gold/tan circular dots positioned above and below the value cards as decorative separators
Live: No decorative dots visible; layout uses grid spacing instead

accepted.title: Services section switches from 2×2 grid to single-column stack
accepted.detail:
Design: Four service cards (Estate Planning, Estate Administration, Executor & Trustee Services, Estate Litigation) arranged in a 2×2 grid with the CTA box on the right.
Live: Services stack vertically in a single column; the 'Speak with our experienced lawyers' CTA box moves below all four service items instead of sitting alongside them.
